Initial reviewer script assumed sorted-object definition hashing, nonexistent installer component names and two exact wording variants. Actual Rust serde field order, fixed installer source and actual limitation text were inspected; four reviewer assumptions corrected and all checks repeated. Initial reviewer output retained separately; no project evidence changed.
limitations: No independent live GUI replay or guest full-history/SQLite/private checkpoint verification; parent compact results and actual helper source ordering were checked instead.

Installed licence bytes not independently read from guest: fixed source raw members verified, derived CRLF bytes independently match the recorded installed hash and size, and original/market/runtime pins corroborate.

Only two small synthetic one-chapter EPUB2 code-edit, Chinese existing content preview, ASCII Save As and fresh reopen accepted. EPUBCheck full compliance, EPUB3, advanced features, direct Chinese keyboard input, full bundle licence closure, network downloads, registration, migration, cross-version upgrade, unattended initial notice and GUI update/rollback buttons remain unverified.
